method: Six legal original Grade II clauses reopened from current government/legal-mirror texts and compared to options. PE102 PDF original §2.7 location checked in extracted text, screenshot attempted but failed; specific PE107 exceptions not reopened. Qualified independent legal/technical source QA unavailable.

items.original_question: Finanţarea lucrărilor de electrificare a localităţilor este obligaţia:

original_ABC.C: operatorului de distribuţie în executarea contractului de concesiune

items.contextual_before_editorial: The legal or technical section defines which exact object and operational regime is regulated.
items.contextual_focus_editorial: Distribution concessionaire finances development on local/central request under planning and concession, yet local/state/final user funds can cofinance; A/B not exclusive duty holders.
items.contextual_after_editorial: Art51 scope has operator obligation with allowed cofinancing, not exclusive operator financing.

items.original_question: În cazul existenţei mai multor puncte de delimitare, se consideră un singur loc de consum şi o singură instalaţie de utilizare dacă:

original_ABC.A: instalaţiile din aval aferente fiecărui punct de delimitare sunt legate electric între ele prin reţele ale operatorului de distribuţie;
original_ABC.C: instalaţiile din aval aferente fiecărui punct de delimitare sunt legate electric între ele prin reţele ale utilizatorului.

items.exact_object_source_locator: Ord59/2013 Anexa1 def. instalatie de utilizare
items.contextual_before_editorial: The legal or technical section defines which exact object and operational regime is regulated.
items.contextual_focus_editorial: Several downstream sections form one user installation when interconnected via user networks; mere common ownership or distributor network does not satisfy exact definition.
items.contextual_after_editorial: Special distributed public-lighting loads may constitute additional exception; current 2026 edition and site definition checked only on mirror.

items.original_question: Prevederile standardului de performanţă pentru serviciul de distribuţie nu se aplică în situaţii de:

original_ABC.C: Evenimente accidentale determinate de angajaţii operatorului de distribuţie

items.contextual_before_editorial: The legal or technical section defines which exact object and operational regime is regulated.
items.contextual_focus_editorial: Only legally established and proven force majeure affecting distribution operator excludes applicability. An ordinary accidental outage or operator-caused incident does not automatically qualify.
items.contextual_after_editorial: Legal proof of force majeure is essential; 2025 amendments must be checked for current article scope.

items.original_question: Cererile de racordare pentru locuri de producere cu puteri instalate de până la 50 MW inclusiv şi cele pentru locuri de consum cu puteri maxim simultan absorbite de până la 50 MW inclusiv, se adresează de către solicitanţi:

original_ABC.A: obligatoriu operatorului de distribuţie concesionar din zona respectivă
original_ABC.B: operatorului de transport şi de sistem
original_ABC.C: unui operator de distribuţie care deţine în apropierea locului de producere sau de consum o reţea electrică de distribuţie

items.contextual_before_editorial: The legal or technical section defines which exact object and operational regime is regulated.
items.contextual_focus_editorial: For eligible <=50 MW connections regulations allow the local concessionaire OR another nearby-network distribution operator. Option A says obligatory concessionaire only and is too narrow, B transmission not universal.
items.contextual_after_editorial: C states nearby OD is possible, not automatically every nearby operator; 15/2026 amendments require exact article/version pinning.

items.original_question: Neplata facturilor emise de către furnizor conform prevederilor contractului de furnizare a energiei electrice poate avea drept  consecinţă:

original_ABC.B: obligaţia de a reface instalaţia de racordare

items.contextual_before_editorial: The legal or technical section defines which exact object and operational regime is regulated.
items.contextual_focus_editorial: A supplier can request interruption for invoice nonpayment according to contract; buyer notice is required before interruption and the distributor performs the physical action.
items.contextual_after_editorial: Art26(4) notice of minimum 15 days domestic and 5 business days non-domestic competitive contracts in the examined text; it is not an automatic contravention fine.

items.original_question: ANRE poate suspenda Atestatul acordat unui operator economic  care proiectează, execută şi verifică  instalaţii electrice dacă:

original_ABC.A: operatorul economic nu îndeplineşte criteriile de bonitate financiară corespunzătoare procedurii aplicabile
original_ABC.B: Operatorul economic a  executat lucrări fără să aibă, în proprietate sau în folosinţă, conform prevederilor Regulamentului, dotarea tehnică minimală corespunzătoare tipului de atestat  deţinut
original_ABC.C: ANRE nu are competenţa de a retrage Atestatele emise

items.exact_object_source_locator: Ord134/2021 Regulament Art30(1)(a) plus Anexa6 equipment obligation
items.contextual_before_editorial: The legal or technical section defines which exact object and operational regime is regulated.
items.contextual_focus_editorial: Regulator MAY suspend accreditation when validity-condition obligations are violated; required minimum technical material equipment must be owned or lawfully used for relevant accreditation.
items.contextual_after_editorial: Art30 is discretionary and refers to valid obligations; do not invert into automatic mandatory suspension or financial bonity rule.

items.original_question: Amplasarea instalaţiilor electrice de conexiuni şi distribuţie în interiorul încăperilor de cabluri:

original_ABC.C: nu există în prescripţiile energetice o prevedere în acest sens

items.contextual_focus_editorial: PE102 original clause prohibits electrical connection/distribution installation INSIDE cable rooms except exceptions specifically in PE107. This is not a generic I7 building wiring rule.
